page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a running head centred at the top; page number at top left; no marginal notes beyond the right edge fragments.

main_text.head: LE TI vel TE LE.
main_text.p: Illas tibi: Le ti, vel te le raccomandò: &, Raccomădólleti, vel Raccomădóttele: Illas tibi commendauit.
main_text.head: LE SI, vel SE LE.
main_text.p: Illas sibi: Le si, vel se le prése, & Préselesi, vel Présesele per compágne: Illas sibi socias asciuit.
main_text.head: LE NE, vel NE LE
main_text.p: Illas nobis Le ne, vel ne le, raccomandò:&, Raccomandóllene, vel Raccomandónnele: Illas nobis commendauit.
Illas hinc, illinc, iftinc: Lene, vel ne le menò: &, Menóllene, vel Menónnele: Illas hinc, illinc, iftinc abduxit.
main_text.head: LE CI, vel CE LE
main_text.p: Illas nob. Le ci vel ce le raccomandò: & Raccomădólleci, vel Raccomădóccele: Illas nobis commendauit.
Illas illic: Le ci, vel ce le vidi:&, Vidileci, vel Vidicele: Illas illic vidi.
Illas illuc: Le ci, vel cele menái, &, Menáileci, vel Menáicele, illas illuc duxi.

page.notes: Right edge is cut off by the scan; the last line reads "Eiillic" as far as legible. Some words at the right margin are partly lost.
